SELECT id,
       to_status,
       COALESCE(is_processing, 0) AS is_processing,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(
           SECOND,
           update_time,
           CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')
       ) AS lock_age_sec
FROM transfer_order_putaway
WHERE id = '{{node:code_node_kku8SAT9.data.lockId}}'
  AND is_deleted = 0
LIMIT 1
